angle_en: Casting aside the bow and arrows

en.intro: Arjuna has just spoken his despair. Sanjaya watches him drop his weapons and sink down. Listen to the weight of what he casts aside.
en.notice: Arjuna casts aside his bow and arrows, his hands letting go of the very instruments of his duty, and he sits down in the middle of the battlefield.
en.next: Sanjaya now turns to the moment when Krishna speaks to Arjuna, whose eyes are full of tears and clouded with grief.
en.meaning: Sanjaya says: Saying this, Arjuna sat down on the chariot seat in the midst of the battlefield, casting aside his bow and arrows, his mind overwhelmed by grief.

hi.intro: अर्जुन ने अभी-अभी अपनी निराशा व्यक्त की है। संजय उन्हें अपने हथियार छोड़कर रथ पर नीचे बैठते हुए देखते हैं। सुनिए वे क्या त्याग रहे हैं।
hi.meaning: संजय कहते हैं कि ऐसा कहकर, शोक से व्याकुल मन वाले अर्जुन बाणों सहित अपना धनुष छोड़कर युद्धभूमि में रथ के मध्य भाग में बैठ गए।
hi.notice: अर्जुन अपने धनुष और बाण त्याग देते हैं, और युद्धभूमि के बीच में रथ पर बैठ जाते हैं।
hi.next: संजय अब उस क्षण की ओर मुड़ते हैं जब कृष्ण, आंसुओं और शोक से भरे अर्जुन से ये शब्द कहते हैं।

en.intro: Arjuna has just spoken his despair. Sanjaya watches him drop his weapons and sink down. Listen to the weight of what he casts aside.
en.body: Sanjaya says: Saying this, Arjuna sat down on the chariot seat in the midst of the battlefield, casting aside his bow and arrows, his mind overwhelmed by grief. Arjuna casts aside his bow and arrows, his hands letting go of the very instruments of his duty, and he sits down in the middle of the battlefield. Sanjaya now turns to the moment when Krishna speaks to Arjuna, whose eyes are full of tears and clouded with grief.

issues: meaning_changed: "अर्जुन अपने धनुष और बाण त्याग देते हैं, अपने हाथों से अपने कर्तव्य के साधन छोड़ देते हैं, और युद्धभूमि के बीच में रथ पर बैठ जाते हैं।" (The phrase 'अपने हाथों से अपने कर्तव्य के साधन छोड़ देते हैं' (letting go of the instruments of his duty with his hands) introduces a physical action (hands letting go) and a philosophical interpretation (instruments of duty) that are not explicitly stated in the source. The source says he cast aside the bow and arrows and sat down, but does not specify the action of 'hands letting go' or frame it as 'duty's instruments'.)
